trigger.note: No second ST and no round-level feature trigger that opens a separate event. M153 mode_1 is a single self-settling paid base reel-spin (st140 NormalCollectionSpin). The only stateful mechanic is the CollectCount collect-WINDOW carried WITHIN st140 (a bonus symbol = pid 9 with WIN==0 arms CC=3, then CC decrements 3->2->1->0; the window spins CC=1/CC=2 pay ~132% RTP vs ~80.55% base — W1 §6, reproduced exactly in W3). This is an intra-ST state dimension, NOT a trigger into a new SpinType, so there is no opens/payid trigger. pid 9 is already a (zero-paying) row in st140's natural PayoutIdToWinAmount — no SynthesizePayIdRule needed (W3 §2).

validation.evidence: session_artifacts/_onboard/M153/01_understanding.md (W1: 40,000 rounds, single real v3 chunk_0002, single md5 bucket 3b832ba3/83a22cc6; exactly ONE ST st140=paid NormalCollectionSpin; settlement self-contained — sum(WinCredits)==sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount)==sum(analysisResult SummaryWin)==34,189,300 exact; per-robot parse==analysisResult 8/8; hit 22.47%, RTP 85.47%; CollectCount 3->2->1->0 decrement window armed by pid 9 bonus (1878 triggers ⟺ pid9 ⟺ 1 bonus symbol, 1:1:1:1), window CC1/CC2 RTP ~132% vs base 80.55%) + 02_reuse.md (W2: live engine on the real chunk; st140 EXACT signature match to M279/M278 st140 -> STRICT-REUSE 4 PER_SPINTYPE plugins verbatim, 3-layer + gates PASS, feature_errors null, rtp_integrity passed, layer2_fallback_buckets_found []; collect_mechanic BCM heuristic false-positive on the decrement CollectCount but RTP-INERT [estimated_correction_pp=null, RTP_CONTRIBUTION=False] -> framework FLAG not ABORT; collect-WINDOW is genuinely-new mechanic, W3 to decide plugin). W3 (this 03_design.md): role 'paid_spin' (existing KNOWN_ROLES token, no extension), play 'NormalCollectionSpin'; ZERO new plugins — st140 fully covered by the strict-reused PER_SPINTYPE spine which IS the machine's own SummaryWin multiplier/payid taxonomy; attribution = st140's OWN PayoutIdToWinAmount (sum(payid)==summary==34,189,300, fallback 0, NO SynthesizePayIdRule); NO role/play analysis attaches (no player_choice/respin/freespin/hold_respin role, no WinMiniGame/Wheel play). The collect-WINDOW felt ladder (CC0 80.55% / CC1 133.78% / CC2 131.37% / CC3 87.74%, transition matrix, 132.55% window uplift) is PARSER-BLIND at the base-excluded layer (parser emits spin_type_bucket_* keyed by SpinType ONLY — keys ['140'] — NOT by CollectCount; spin_type_next_counts {'140':{'140':39992}} carries no window signal) -> a labeled CC-state x tier breakout needs a per-CC parser accumulator (base-closure, flips base_hash) = framework-team; its payback is ALREADY fully attributed inside st140 (no RTP orphaned), so no invariant cost.
caveats: ZERO new plugins: st140 is a clean STRICT-REUSE of the 4 PER_SPINTYPE plugins (the machine's own SummaryWin tier x feature taxonomy). No role/play analysis attaches (roles={paid_spin}, plays={NormalCollectionSpin} — neither keys ROLE_ANALYSES/PLAY_ANALYSES). No KNOWN_ROLES extension. Simplest onboard in the fleet.

ATTRIBUTION: st140 self-attributes via its OWN PayoutIdToWinAmount — sum(payid)==spin_type_win[140]==summary==34,189,300 with all 9 natural payids present (pid 9 bonus trigger correctly pays 0). NO settlement ST, NO empty-payid round -> NO SynthesizePayIdRule (unlike M279 ST2 / M278 ST160). W2 proved layer2_fallback_buckets_found [].

collect_mechanic BCM heuristic FALSE-POSITIVE (framework-team, fleet-wide class): the CROSS_CUTTING BCM plugin auto-fires and reads M153's DECREMENT 3->2->1->0 collect-window as a failed INCREMENT-to-threshold cycle (total_collects 24, avg_spins_between_collects 1666, cycle_observation 'no reset, cycle_len >= 3' — all BCM-frame artifacts with no meaning for M153's mechanic). RTP-INERT (estimated_correction_pp=null, bonus_cycle_correction.applicable=false, RTP_CONTRIBUTION=False) -> corrupts NO invariant (summary.rtp 85.47% = Σ st140 payid rtp_pp exact). A NEW face of the same heuristic-precision class M275/M279/M278 document: the heuristic does not distinguish increment-to-threshold BCM from a decrement collect-window. Do NOT patch in onboarding (shared CROSS_CUTTING file, re-flags every BCM machine). Framework-team heuristic-hardening item.

parser_blind (framework-team, NEVER fabricated): the collect-WINDOW felt ladder — CollectCount-state x win-tier x RTP (CC0 80.55% / CC1 133.78% / CC2 131.37% / CC3 87.74%, window CC1+CC2 132.55% vs base 80.55%; 3->2->1->0 transition matrix {(0,3):1646,(3,2):1801,(2,1):1726,(1,0):1646} + re-arms {(1,3):80,(2,3):75,(3,3):76}; trigger 1878 ⟺ pid9 ⟺ 1 bonus symbol 1:1:1:1; W1 §6, reproduced exactly in W3 §1c) — is NOT base-derivable: the parser emits spin_type_bucket_{spins,bet,win} keyed by SpinType ONLY (verified keys ['140'], no per-CollectCount slice) and spin_type_next_counts {'140':{'140':39992}} (single ST self-transition, no window signal). Surfacing a LABELED CC-state x tier breakout (and the window-uplift / trigger-rate / 3-step ladder) needs a per-CollectCount paid-round bucket accumulator in core/parser.py (a base-closure file; analogous to spin_type_bucket_* sliced by CC value) — flips base_hash, framework-team scope (same boundary as M279 move-burst-length / wheel CellIndex map / M278 burst-length curve). NO invariant cost: every collect-window win is already attributed inside st140 (Σ payid rtp_pp = 85.473 = summary.rtp, fallback 0); the window is a felt-experience DRILLDOWN of already-accounted payback, not a missing payback source.

CollectCount substantive CC=1 vs CC=2 semantic (W1 §8.1): no board-state field predicts which collect-step a spin is — pure carried state; the underlying collect-meter/accumulator value (if any beyond the 0-3 counter) is not exposed by any round field; 'what is being collected' is not in the rawdata. A could-not-determine data fact (not a fabricated mechanic).

payid -> base-symbol exact identity is fuzzy/many-to-one (pid 7 spans high7/2bar/low7/mid7 'any-7' 3oak; pid 8 spans bars). payouts_by_spin_type reports the solo-win-board MAJORITY combo as an ASSOCIATION, not a 1:1 paytable identity (W1 §4, §8.2). Not a defect — the payback attribution is exact regardless.

under-sampled rare events (single ~40k chunk, FLAGGED do-not-fetch, W1 §8.3): tier-300 band n=1 (one 416,500 win); pid 1002/payoutid 101 (wild 2-of-a-kind) n=4; pid 1 n=2; 3-wild board n=4 (RTP 3499% is one-event noise). Structurally present, statistically unstable at this sample. The strict-reused plugins surface them as low-n rows; do not over-read their per-event multipliers.

SymbolIndexToRewards ('{}') and CreditsSymbols ('') empty on 100% of rounds (W1 §8.5) — carry no settlement info in this mode; kept in signature for forward-compat (reason-for-empty undetermined, proven empty).

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' present on every st140 round but =0 on 100% of 40,000 in-sample records (W1 §7, §8.4). The established fleet-wide pattern (user-confirmed 2026-06-12; M275/M279/M278 precedent, gate-8 declaration protocol): a real progressive jackpot store that the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0; the sample correctly shows 0. Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the st140 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface populates it, the parser picks it up unchanged. The reported RTP (85.47%) is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive). Nothing else is declared hidden for M153 (gate-8: data-invisible defaults absent unless platform-declared).
